answer: Dishonest graders are slashed and their stake is redistributed, which means a Sybil cluster that tries to vote as a bloc will, on average, lose more from slashing than it gains from manipulating a single verdict. It survives because reputation is spent fast and earned slowly, so any alias that ever cheats loses value that is expensive to replace. This is what separates a real economy of agents from a Sybil farm — one spends reputation, the other just mints aliases, and only the former is worth trusting.
